top_signals.title: Vietnam Weighs Wider Daily Stock Trading Band After FTSE Upgrade
top_signals.summary: Vietnam is considering widening the daily trading band for stocks to make its market more attractive to investors following an upgrade to emerging-market status by FTSE Russell, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: More is being paid out by advanced economies in debt interest than the whole world spends on AI, defense or clean technology.
